claims.description: Owning-tab highlight restored on pushed screens. New pure resolveV2TabIsActive(pathname, tabName, v2Enabled, reactNavigationFocused) resolves the visually-active V2 tab from the pathname's owning tab (accountReturnTokenForPathname) instead of React Navigation focus, which reports false for all three real tab buttons while a hidden-sibling pushed screen is active. Wired into the Mentor/Subjects/Journal tabBarIcon/tabBarLabel; V2-gated (V0/V1 pass reactNavigationFocused straight through). File-level pointer: (app) route path breaks path:line resolution; resolveV2TabIsActive is defined near line 285.

Guard test proving the AC-1 fix red-green-revert: describe('resolveV2TabIsActive [WI-2331 AC-1]'). Reverting to unconditional reactNavigationFocused fails the owning-tab-for-pushed-route cases; restore passes. Cited in docs/evidence/wi2331-rgr-v2-wayfinding.md Defect 1.

AC-2 narrowed by PM AC-scope ruling (clacks mentomate-pgm seq 39322, 2026-07-23) to the root-level dead-V0-fallback screens; exhaustive ~76-file semantic-Back sweep split to WI-2677. Root-cause fix: homeHrefForReturnTo gained a v2Enabled param (defined at line 141); its catch-all now routes through the owning-tab contract when V2 is on instead of the retired /(app)/home. Named tokens above the catch-all and the v2Enabled=false default are untouched, so V0/V1 does not regress.

mentor-memory Back control (header chevron + load-timeout + error-state secondary actions, one handleBack near line 234) derives backFallback/backLabel from the V2 nav flag: V2 on routes and names the owning Mentor tab; V2 off keeps the original /(app)/more + generic label byte-for-byte. After the origin/main reconcile, handleBack also preserves main's JOURNAL_RETURN_TO branch (WI-2239). File-level pointer: (app) route path.

V0/V1 must-not-regress and homeHrefForReturnTo behavior asserted by navigation.test.ts (catch-all still returns /(app)/home with V2 off; every pre-existing 2-arg token assertion unchanged). Red-green-revert for the catch-all in docs/evidence/wi2331-rgr-v2-wayfinding.md Defect 2.

Focused journeys (active session / onboarding) keep an explicit exit and restore prior context. session screen handleChatBackPress last-resort branch (near line 532) routes to the owning Mentor tab under V2 instead of the dead /(app)/home; the MENTOR_RETURN_TO path (main's WI-2234 mentor-return epoch hydration) is preserved in the merge. File-level pointer: (app) route path.

AC-4 REMOVED per PM AC-scope ruling (clacks mentomate-pgm seq 39322, relayed to this lane at seq 39333, 2026-07-23) as a type correction: net-new persistent own/supporting identity UI (avatar + Your learning / Supporting {name}) is a Feature, not a Bug deviation-from-intended-behavior, so nothing equivalent exists to deviate from. The ruling was executed in place on the Cosmo AC field ([REMOVED] marker, original text preserved). Split to WI-2678 (Feature), minted and linked before completion (mint-before-complete) and orchestrator-verified (clacks seq 40193; WI-2331 Related Items include WI-2678). No code deliverable on this Bug. Provenance and the full AC-reconciliation table are recorded in the pointer's Scope reconciliation and provenance section.

One central route-to-owning-tab, return-label, and active-context contract (accountReturnTokenForPathname, homeHrefForReturnTo, V2_TAB_TITLE_KEYS) backs both the tab highlight (AC-1) and every Back target (AC-2/AC-3), so they cannot disagree; every fix is v2Enabled-gated and the shipped V0/V1 flag states are preserved.

AC-5 audit of all V2 back-routes: the full ~78-file back-navigation audit enumeration (the audit that feeds the split-out sweep WI-2677) is committed as in-repo evidence. Representative regression coverage across all three tabs, own/supporting contexts, deep links, and V0/V1-preserved paths is proven by the AC-1/AC-2 guard suites and the red-green-revert cycles in docs/evidence/wi2331-rgr-v2-wayfinding.md.
